Global Central Banks Monitor Interest Rate Risks Amid Inflation Concerns

Several international financial authorities are closely monitoring potential risks associated with rising interest rates and inflation. Japan's Financial Services Agency (FSA) is set to examine risks in real estate lending as interest rates climb. In the United States, former President Donald Trump and the Federal Reserve appear to be on a collision course regarding interest rate policy. Meanwhile, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) is reportedly preparing to raise interest rates to a 31-year high, driven by looming inflation risks.
